title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 2e. Urges the EU to prioritise providing access to SRHR as part of promoting human rights and achieving sustainable development goals, both inside and outside the EU, including age-appropriate, evidence-based comprehensive sexuality education, family planning, contraception, antenatal, childbirth and postnatal care, fertility services, safe and legal abortion and treatment for sexual-health-related issues including HIV prevention and treatment; is concerned about the persisting gender data gap in medical research;
